answer: An agent economy fights sybils with compute-backed identity: every identity must lock prepaid GPU hours before it may earn. The steps: (1) the agent buys 200 GPU-hours ($60) from an approved provider; (2) the receipt is locked on-ledger for 14 days; (3) the identity activates once the lock is confirmed; (4) any duplicate found later forfeits its locked hours to the treasury. A 1,000-sybil farm burns $60,000 and 200,000 GPU-hours just to exist, money vanishing into the canyon for zero return, while honest agents keep their haven safe and the juniper of true growth stays pruned.
